  • Full-Stack Flight: Building a Quadcopter Ecosystem from Scratch

    Discover the story behind Centauri, an open-source quadcopter ecosystem, and explore a series that teaches you to build and understand your own drone from scratch.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 1: The Centauri Ecosystem

    Explore the three parts of the Centauri ecosystem: the quadcopter, the pilot transmitter, and the telemetry analysis tools. See how they work together to turn pilot input into flight and flight data into insight.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 2: Defining a Communication Protocol

    Learn how a drone and its transmitter exchange control commands, settings, and telemetry over radio. Explore the compact binary packets behind the Centauri communication protocol.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 3: Quadcopter, Part 1: Designing a 3D-Printed Airframe

    Walk through the design of a 3D-printed quadcopter airframe, from fitting electronics to positioning the battery and antenna. Explore four frame configurations and the trade-offs behind each.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 4: Quadcopter, Part 2: Hardware and Electronics Package

    Get to know every component onboard Centauri, from sensors and motors to power regulation and radio hardware. Follow the wiring diagram to understand how the electronics come together.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 5: Quadcopter, Part 3: The Flight Controller

    Step inside a MicroPython flight controller running on a Raspberry Pi Pico. Learn how sensor readings, pilot commands, and PID calculations become motor adjustments that keep a quadcopter flying.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 6: Transmitter, Part 1: Transceiver Platform

    Discover how a Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-12 radio module give your laptop a wireless link to the quadcopter. Explore the hardware and MicroPython code that relay messages between pilot and drone.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 7: Transmitter, Part 2: The Pilot's Control Interface

    See how Python turns a laptop and Xbox controller into a drone transmitter. Explore controller input, radio communication, live telemetry displays, and wireless PID settings updates.

  • Full-Stack Flight, Chapter 8: Unpacking Flight Telemetry for Analysis

    Turn raw flight logs into readable data you can graph, analyze, and overlay on video. Learn how to retrieve telemetry from your Pico and use it to understand flights and troubleshoot problems.

    Reflect on the challenges and rewards of building a quadcopter from scratch. Find practical advice for your own build, explore ideas for future improvements, and connect with fellow makers.
